patterns.note: Full-width content sections with distinct, often high-contrast, background colors that alternate as the user scrolls down the page.
Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typography is used for primary headings and project titles, creating a dominant visual element that often fills the width of the screen.
A vibrant, high-contrast color palette is used, primarily featuring black, white, and a distinctive lime green, accented by bright blues, reds, and pinks for section backgrounds.
The main 'ONWARDS' logo in the top left corner remains sticky and fixed in position as the user scrolls, while all other page content scrolls underneath it.
Large project titles and section headings appear to animate into view with a subtle fade-up or scale effect as their respective sections enter the viewport.
Each portfolio project is presented as a distinct, full-width section featuring a unique background color and an extremely large, bold text title.

technique_notes: A fixed header element containing the primary site logo is positioned at the top-left of the viewport, allowing all subsequent page content to scroll beneath it without obscuring the logo.
Content sections are designed as full-bleed blocks, each assigned a unique background color that transitions abruptly as the user scrolls from one section to the next.

Key textual elements, such as large project names and section headings, are revealed with a subtle, staggered animation (e.g., a slight fade-in and upward translation) as they become visible within the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~8-10x body text) for section and project titles, with a clear hierarchy down to smaller, lighter body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous vertical spacing between sections, large negative space around headings and project titles)

standout: This site's design is highly distinctive due to its aggressive use of oversized, bold typography for section and project titles, combined with a vibrant, high-contrast color palette that shifts dramatically between full-width sections. This creates a dynamic and impactful visual rhythm that feels both modern and playful, avoiding a generic template feel.
